findings.message: No set_input_delay — all input ports are unconstrained.
No set_output_delay — all output ports are unconstrained.
No set_propagated_clock — ideal clock model is over-optimistic for post-layout correlation.
No sdc_version declaration. Add 'set sdc_version 2.2' at the top.
No set_units — add 'set_units -time ns -capacitance pF' to avoid unit mismatches.
No set_max_fanout — consider set_max_fanout 20 [all_inputs].
No set_max_transition — add set_max_transition 0.2 [all_nets].
No set_max_capacitance.
No set_load on outputs.
No set_driving_cell / set_input_transition / set_drive — input slew is ideal.
No set_clock_latency — model insertion delay with set_clock_latency -source before CTS.
No set_clock_transition — constrain clock slew with set_clock_transition 0.1 [all_clocks].
No set_case_analysis — use for scan_en, test_mode to prevent DFT paths dominating timing.
No set_ideal_network — mark reset/scan_en as ideal.
No set_dont_use — consider excluding weak/problematic cells.
No set_operating_conditions — specify PVT corner explicitly.
No set_timing_derate — needed for AOCV/POCVM advanced signoff.
No set_clock_jitter — model random jitter separately from uncertainty.
No group_path — improves synthesis optimization focus on critical interfaces.
No set_clock_gating_check — needed if design uses clock gating cells.
No wire load constraints — needed for flows without extracted RC.
No set_max_area — add area target for synthesis.
No power constraints.

scope_limitation: Netlist-dependent checks could not be evaluated without design context.
